complete_examples.text: By employing the analysis framework, Fig. 11 shows the settlement threshold including pier settlement and bending deformation of foundation settlement under different vehicle speed.
When the train speed is 250 km/h, 300 km/h, 350 km/h., the threshold of the foundation settlement reduction rate is 10~30%.
